title: Finns love blueberries – level 1
paragraphs: Blueberries are very special in Finland. People love them. In summer, many people go to the forest to pick them. They can do it freely. Families go together. Children learn from their parents where to pick blueberries.

Blogger Varpu Rusila says that picking blueberries is fun and a way to love nature. Finnish people eat blueberries every day. They put them in porridge, pie, ice cream, and smoothies. Wild blueberries are small and very tasty. They also help people stay strong and healthy.
In Helsinki, people see blueberries in many places. Shops and cafés sell food with blueberries. For Finnish people, blueberries mean health, family time, and love for the forest.
